# Introducing Trailpeak: Teva’s First High Performance Daily Trail Running Shoe Co-Created with the Brand’s Bureau of Adventure Athletes


September 01, 2026 9:00am EDT


The Teva Trailpeak pairs lightweight cushioning, reliable traction, and a secure fit for confident, everyday trail running


GOLETA, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--[Teva](http://teva.com/) , a division of Deckers Brands (NYSE: DECK), announces the launch of its newest high performance daily trail running shoe and the brand’s first footwear fully co-created with athletes from Teva’s[Bureau of Adventure](https://www.teva.com/bureau-of-adventure) (TBA): Trailpeak.


This press release features multimedia. View the full release here:[https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20260901784507/en/](https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20260901784507/en/)


Teva Bureau of Adventure athlete, Erin Ton


Optimized for epic days out, Trailpeak excels as a daily trainer with a knack for fast-moving mountain adventures. Lightweight, responsive and secure, the shoe is designed for runners looking for a fun, nimble ride that feels just as at home on an everyday trail run as it does when the day turns into something bigger.


TBA ultrarunners[Erin Ton](https://www.instagram.com/erin_ton7/?hl=en) and[Mike Wardian](https://www.instagram.com/mikewardian/?hl=en) played an integral role in the shoe’s development, testing early prototypes and providing real-world feedback throughout the design process. Alongside a broader group of Teva athletes and testers, their insights helped fine-tune everything from responsiveness and fit to stability and overall feel.


“Trailpeak represents a new approach to innovation at Teva,” said Zack Paris, Director of Advanced Concepts & Innovation at Teva. “As our first co-created product with the Teva Bureau of Adventure, it showcases the power of designing alongside athletes who put our products to the test every day. From early concepts through real-world testing in demanding environments, their insights shaped every stage of development, resulting in a trail runner built to excel on our athlete's shorter, faster pursuits.”


The Trailpeak pairs Teva’s lightest and most responsive HYPER-COMF+® midsole cushioning with a speedlace fit system for quick, on-the-go adjustments. A secure internal support cage uses 12 individual anchor points to provide lateral support and a dialed-in fit, while Spider Rubber® Endure delivers reliable traction underfoot. Together, the technologies create a lightweight, agile trail shoe designed to keep runners connected and confident across changing trail conditions.


**TRAILPEAK BY THE NUMBERS:**


- **Sizes:** Women’s 5–11 / Men’s 7–14
- **MSRP:** $160 USD
- **Stack:** Men’s 30.5/24.5mm; Women’s 29.5/23.5mm
- **Drop:** 6mm
- **Lug Height:** 3mm
- **Weight:** 8.3 oz / 235g (Men’s 9); 6.5 oz / 185g (Women’s 7)
- **Athletes & Testers:** 25
- **Miles Tested:** 1,500
- **Testing Grounds:** 9+ mountain ranges across the U.S., Canada and Peru


“The Trailpeak deserves a spot in the quiver as a reliable option for everyday trail runs,” said Erin Ton, TBA mountain endurance athlete. “Running in these shoes feels light, fast, and free. It provides cushion and comfort yet maintains ground feel that connects you to the Earth. Consider this shoe an announcement that Teva is here to play in the trail running space.”


Trailpeak represents the brand’s inaugural shoe fully co-created with Teva athletes, with additional TBA products currently in development.


Trailpeak is now available for purchase at[Teva.com](http://teva.com/c/trailpeak) along with limited release at select retailers across the U.S. including[Fleet Feet Menlo Park](https://www.fleetfeet.com/s/menlopark?srsltid=AfmBOoprkRaXe_ZpdbO6Sh0ONT_xIEBFE5ozbZJyYcvT7jZ__ENRFFoC) ,[Gearhead Outfitters Chattanooga](https://gearheadoutfitters.com/?srsltid=AfmBOor5oJ0G7EvrM17zHx9UKeY34S9IwMj6dqURQP3JBthjbusIIKss) ,[Outdoor Gear Exchange](https://www.gearx.com/?srsltid=AfmBOopUXqOk1vifGGz5BmEuIeWIb1H3I4FnFaA3bZCx3c6-z_ALC396) ,[Paragon Sports](https://paragonsports.com/?srsltid=AfmBOopSfPet7tCQ7k7dBgIy-IRUDFHMrWQW1UdoaMmYkGFHcX9GZESt) ,[Running Warehouse](https://www.runningwarehouse.com/?srsltid=AfmBOorZLy55tnjtOJ5NvhAIchljw0D3THPKsRZNjSN7JEcxtXiSeJBW) ,[Skinny Skis](https://skinnyskis.com/) ,[Ute Mountaineer](https://www.utemountaineer.com/) , and[Whole Earth Provision Co](https://www.wholeearthprovision.com/?srsltid=AfmBOoodU7oSL3FyDJQDjgyhXrKz0WGi4-LPzLFvyc_4pcSGHjwTdM8i) .


**About Teva®**


Since creating the world’s first sport sandal in 1984, Teva’s mission has been to equip adventurers across the globe to play outside. For over four decades, Teva has created proven gear to inspire adventurers to get dirt in their teeth, dance around fires, backflip into life’s waters and howl into the wind. While being mindful of its impact on the planet, Teva is committed to developing products with innovative materials and thoughtful designs to encourage people to get outside and get a little wild on playground Earth. Learn more about Teva, a division of Deckers Brands, at teva.com or follow @Teva.


**About Deckers Brands**


Deckers Brands is a global leader in designing, marketing, and distributing innovative footwear, apparel, and accessories developed for both everyday casual lifestyle use and high-performance activities. The Company’s portfolio of brands includes UGG®, HOKA®, and Teva®. Deckers Brands products are sold in more than 50 countries and territories through select department and specialty stores, Company-owned and operated retail stores, and select online stores, including Company-owned websites. Deckers Brands has over 50 years of history building niche footwear brands into lifestyle market leaders attracting millions of loyal consumers globally. For more information, please visit[www.deckers.com](http://www.deckers.com/) .


**About TBA**


Teva Bureau of Adventure (TBA), the brand’s new adventure athlete program, launched in 2025 and was designed to support the evolution of Teva’s functional performance footwear category. Teva’s inaugural adventure athletes include ultrarunners[Mike Wardian](https://www.instagram.com/mikewardian/?hl=en) ,[Erin Ton](https://www.instagram.com/erin_ton7/?hl=en) , and[Hunter Leininger](https://www.instagram.com/hunter_leininger/?hl=en) , plus professional kayakers[Dane Jackson](https://www.instagram.com/danejacksonkayak/?hl=en) ,[Evy Liebfarth](https://www.instagram.com/evykayak/?hl=en) , and[Sofia Reinoso](https://www.instagram.com/sofireinoso/?hl=en) , and professional fly fishers[Shyanne Orvis](https://www.instagram.com/shyonthefly/?hl=en) and[Alvin Dedeaux](https://www.instagram.com/alvin_dedeaux_fly_fishing/?hl=en) . Wardian holds the record for completing seven marathons on seven continents in seven days, while Ton has amassed more than[200 Fastest Known Times](https://fastestknowntime.com/athlete/erin-ton) (FKTs)—the most of any female athlete.
